records.rule: Address is one unstructured patient-address candidate mapped only to patients.address.
Decode latin1, NFC and outer-trim; preserve internal display text; comparison whitespace collapse only.
Blank maps null plus absence provenance.
Reject decode failure, controls/noncharacters and values over operational max 500 at field level.
Do not parse, geocode, split punctuation or infer city, town, region, postal code or digital address.
Do not copy organisation address into a patient address.
Address is prohibited for patient identity, matching and deduplication.
Existing target address and locality fields are immutable; record protected comparison only.
Raw address is protected; repository/log output is aggregate only.
Parent unresolved or quarantined holds the field under the patient root.
Extraction/snapshot failure withholds the field and root until reproducible.
